candidate_questions.prompt: Let q be a unitless number, defined by q = (1 - ((5 / 6) * (7 / 9))). What is its exact value?
candidate_questions.explanation: Multiply by the reciprocal: 5 / 6 = 5 * (1/6) = 5/6. Multiply by the reciprocal: 7 / 9 = 7 * (1/9) = 7/9. Multiply numerators and denominators: (5/6) * (7/9) = 35/54. Common denominator 54: 1 - (35/54) = (54/54) - (35/54) = 19/54. The answer is 19/54.
